test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GAINED : NEDGAI :: KINDLY : DLYKIN :: JUNIOR : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

GAINED : NEDGAI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab0fb34d45ac0fc967e6ddb623f48e58c36353d632c39cba38cd1dabf5e5498.png] 

And,

KINDLY : DLYKIN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e053eb3fc5b4540f71a997563c285fc886cf74c8dc73b93e88e2819485f81c3.png] 

Similarly,

JUNIOR : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8441ef1f45e68816643e5bc63e72b0752738ca820d22259da1bca12941ed88e7.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
